name: AntitoneOn.integral_le_sum
statement: AntitoneOn f (Icc x₀ (x₀ + a))) : (∫ x in x₀..x₀ + a, f x) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, f (x₀ + i)

have_tree.name: hint
have_tree.type: ∀ k : ℕ, k < a → IntervalIntegrable f volume (x₀ + k) (x₀ + (k + 1 : ℕ))

name: AntitoneOn.sum_le_integral
statement: AntitoneOn f (Icc x₀ (x₀ + a))) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, f (x₀ + (i + 1 : ℕ))) ≤ ∫ x in x₀..x₀ + a, f x

have_tree.name: hint
have_tree.type: ∀ k : ℕ, k < a → IntervalIntegrable f volume (x₀ + k) (x₀ + (k + 1 : ℕ))
